projections.statement: The CDC publicly identifies a specific implicated food product or source for the US cyclosporiasis outbreak between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-31.
projections.resolution: TRUE if a CDC advisory or public statement between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-31 names a specific food product or source linked to the outbreak; else FALSE.

projections.statement: The government of France declares a national state of emergency or equivalent nationwide wildfire emergency between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-07.
projections.resolution: TRUE if the French national government formally declares a nationwide state of emergency for the wildfires, reported by major press between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-07; else FALSE.

projections.statement: CISA adds the Certighost Active Directory vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-07-25 and 2026-09-15.
projections.resolution: TRUE if a Certighost-related CVE appears in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-07-25 and 2026-09-15; else FALSE.

projections.statement: The US cyclosporiasis case count reported by the CDC exceeds 15000 between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-31.
projections.resolution: TRUE if a CDC report or advisory between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-31 states a case count above 15000 for the cyclosporiasis outbreak; else FALSE.
